## Completed #393 measurement and reviewed residual handoff

Thomas's contextual reading and the GPT-family retest request are answered. His decision, frozen in `ed1d8587`, treats all three supplied Swedish negatives as defective in their full contexts and requires a supported idiomatic repair or a report of the exact unresolved obstruction. It does not prescribe replacement wording or prohibit ordinary Swedish figures. The old fixtures, plans, verdicts and ADR-0212 remain unchanged.

The additive packet from retained source head `4e88c6e0` is integrated in the assigned local `kntnt-orchestrate/main/393` tree for independent Orchestrate verification. The original evidence branch/worktree remain deliverables. [Results](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/results.md), [independent audit](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/integration-2026-10-02/audit.md), [reviewed residual handoff](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/integration-2026-10-02/residual-handoff.md), [Redline record](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/records/redline-gpt-2026-10-01-393.md) and [Write record](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/records/write-gpt-2026-10-01-393.md) are the surviving-main destinations; these new links become available when the maintainer publishes the integration. This task performs no push.

Independent artifact/trace checks confirm twenty counted runs, nineteen delivered artifacts and one permitted no-change status, with 54 fresh children and two independent blind judges. Five construction refusals, eight unsent turns and two voids are separate. The Swedish negatives yield two agreed repairs, three mandatory-finding misses and one disputed unresolved report. All three fresh Swedish preparation translations pass. Seven of eight positive quotation controls preserve the target; one unnecessarily expands the working English quotation. The third source-blind pair supplies no delivered text, so its text-dependent criteria remain skipped.

Redline still has measured quotation misses. These are results on unchanged `fb169087`, GPT `gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh`, native Codex CLI 0.159.3; they do not accept the whole product or certify later main. Encrypted dispatches, resource-return gaps and the omitted British mechanics passage retain their stated limits.

The seven local proposals have been reviewed against frozen/current contracts and tracker ownership. Six reviewable local briefs retain the verified quotation, mechanical quotation-boundary, unique heading agency/scope, foreign-directory cleanup and excerpt-boundary residuals. The proposed authorship defect is rejected under the explicit disclosed-user-byline fallback. The English bridge-removal allegation is unestablished against the shipped redundant-pre-echo rule. Both original raw judge allegations remain preserved; disputed/skipped observations create no demonstrated defect. No new issue has been filed.

All four CONTRIBUTING checks were executed on the integrated evidence. Ruff, formatting and mypy passed; pytest returned three scheduler-test failures and 2,727 passes. Their fixtures assume a temporary home outside the real account home, while this builder is required to keep all temporary writes inside its assigned scratch path under `/Users/thomas`. The account gate therefore correctly recognises those paths as inside the real account. [The failure receipt and required decision](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/blob/main/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/integration-2026-10-02/gate-boundary.md) are retained; no test or product is changed to obtain a green result. Completion requires permission for an external temporary root or separately scoped test correction. No product file, historical evidence or ADR changed, and no new product run, installation or release occurred. The builder stops at that boundary. Under Thomas's completion-authority clarification, closure stays pending until the gate and fresh independent verification confirm this bounded task. Closure does not say the residual defects are repaired.

Builder attempt: `ms-20261002-fa0735`. Independent verification and final integration remain with the run.
